title: Has pricing been formally approved?
prompt: Can we quote the launch rate externally?
whyItMatters: Quoting an unapproved rate creates regulatory and conduct risk.
resolutionNote: Pricing committee minute recorded in Metis.

title: What eligibility wording is approved for external use?
prompt: Which eligibility text can customer and media variants use?
whyItMatters: Mis-stating eligibility creates fair value and customer detriment risk.
resolutionNote: Compliance pack v3 eligibility wording approved with pricing committee.

title: What can we safely say about the green proposition?
prompt: What environmental claims are approved for external use?
whyItMatters: Overclaiming on green outcomes creates legal and reputational risk.
resolutionNote: Legal approved support/linked-to language with anti-overclaiming caveats.

title: Is the app release approved?
prompt: Can we direct customers to the app journey?
whyItMatters: Directing customers to an unavailable journey creates conduct risk.

title: What line should customer operations use before launch?
prompt: What approved agent script is available?
whyItMatters: Agents need a controlled line before announcement.
resolutionNote: Internal staff message variant V1 circulated; go/no-go confirmed announcement authorised.

title: What support wording is needed for assisted digital/vulnerable customers?
prompt: Are assisted digital routes clearly stated in customer variants?
whyItMatters: Vulnerable customers must not be directed to digital-only journeys.
resolutionNote: Reflected in staff V1 and customer V2 variants; ongoing monitoring via watchlist.

title: What should be watched in the first 72 hours after launch?
prompt: What items are on the post-launch watchlist?
whyItMatters: Leadership expects disciplined monitoring after announcement.
resolutionNote: Watchlist brief issued; items to be updated as confirmed during 72-hour window.
